properties.heavy_quadricycle:conditional: yes @ (fuel=electric OR fuel=hydrogen); permit @ (fuel=diesel OR fuel=diesel_hybrid); yes @ (fuel=petrol OR fuel=petrol_hybrid OR fuel=lpg OR fuel=cng OR fuel=lng OR fuel=bioethanol)
properties.microcar:conditional: yes @ (fuel=electric OR fuel=hydrogen); permit @ (fuel=diesel OR fuel=diesel_hybrid); yes @ (fuel=petrol OR fuel=petrol_hybrid OR fuel=lpg OR fuel=cng OR fuel=lng OR fuel=bioethanol)
properties.moped:conditional: yes @ (fuel=electric OR fuel=hydrogen); permit @ (fuel=diesel OR fuel=diesel_hybrid); yes @ (fuel=petrol OR fuel=petrol_hybrid OR fuel=lpg OR fuel=cng OR fuel=lng OR fuel=bioethanol)
properties.motorcycle:conditional: yes @ (fuel=electric OR fuel=hydrogen); permit @ ((fuel=diesel OR fuel=diesel_hybrid) OR ((fuel=petrol OR fuel=petrol_hybrid OR fuel=lpg OR fuel=cng OR fuel=lng OR fuel=bioethanol) AND emissions<euro_3))
properties.motor_vehicle:conditional: yes @ (fuel=electric OR fuel=hydrogen); permit @ (((fuel=diesel OR fuel=diesel_hybrid) AND emissions<euro_6) OR ((fuel=petrol OR fuel=petrol_hybrid OR fuel=lpg OR fuel=cng OR fuel=lng OR fuel=bioethanol) AND emissions<euro_3))
properties.name: Zone de basses émissions Bruxelles - Lage-emissiezone Brussel
properties.note: Brussels labels Motorbike (L6–L7), but L6/L7 are quadricycles (L6e/L7e), not 2-wheel motorcycles; motorcycles/scooters are L3–L5. In OSM, L6e is covered by microcar, and we add heavy_quadricycle for L7e to match Brussels’ combined L6–L7 bucket.
